{{Quote|I have encountered many such groups, including the Cruthauses and the Boughtine. The Force finds a way to express itself.|Qui-Gon Jinn's annotation in his copy of ''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force''|<ref name="TJP" />}}
The '''Boughtine''' was an organization made up of individuals who were [[Force-sensitive/Legends|sensitive]] to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. By [[72 BBY/Legends|72 BBY]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] had made contact with the group. Later, at some point between [[82 BBY/Legends|82 BBY]] and 72 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]], Jinn noted the experience in an annotation made in his copy of the [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi trainee]] [[Book/Legends|guidebook]] ''[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force]]'' in a section devoted to non&ndash;[[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] Force-using organizations other than the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="TJP" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Boughtine was introduced in the [[2010]] reference book [[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']], authored by [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="TJP" />
